@graph.description: A reflective and atmospheric track, blending dreamy synths and poignant lyrics that explore themes of solitude and connection.
@graph.headline: 2raumwohnung - Somebody Lonely and Me (Nacht)

@graph.description: 'Do It To It' by ACRAZE featuring Cherish is a high-energy dance track that blends house music with early 2000s R&B vibes, creating an infectious party anthem.
@graph.headline: ACRAZE - Do It To It (feat. Cherish)

@graph.description: Melodic synths crash into live drums and a snarling rock vocal: Do You opens Freeland's Cope with a breakbeat-punk jolt that sounds like a band and a DJ at war.
@graph.headline: Adam Freeland - Do You

@graph.name: Going Down In A Blaze Of Glory

@graph.description: A deep dive into the haunting realms of dark psychedelic techno, blending hypnotic rhythms with ghostly atmospheres.
@graph.headline: Alic - Going Down In A Blaze Of Glory

@graph.description: A twenty-year-old Alicia Keys at the piano, pouring gospel-sized yearning into a stark, minor-key confession about a love she cannot stop falling into.
@graph.headline: Alicia Keys - Fallin'

@graph.description: 'Forgotten Places' is a mesmerizing downtempo track by Alif Tree. The song blends atmospheric textures with jazzy elements, creating a nostalgic and introspective sonic journey that evokes images of hidden, abandoned spaces reclaimed by nature.
@graph.headline: Alif Tree - Forgotten Places

@graph.description: Alle Farben's sun-warmed deep house meets Graham Candy's quivering, unmistakable falsetto in a wistful Berlin summer song about the days that do not go to plan.
@graph.headline: Alle Farben, Graham Candy - Sometimes

@graph.description: A soulful anthem that blends heartfelt lyrics with a smooth, rhythmic performance, reflecting on the struggles and triumphs of daily life.
@graph.headline: Aloe Blacc - I Need a Dollar (Live)

@graph.description: A lullaby with teeth: alt-J's 2012 breakthrough wraps an obsessive love song, borrowed in part from Where the Wild Things Are, in plucked guitar, close harmonies and a refrain that piles up until it will not let go.
@graph.headline: Breezeblocks | alt-J (∆)

@graph.description: 'DJ' by Amanda Blank is a high-energy electro-rap track with a party vibe, showcasing her dynamic style and bold lyrics.
@graph.headline: Amanda Blank - DJ

@graph.description: A slinking, horn-stabbed confession of infidelity, sung by Amy Winehouse with brutal honesty over Mark Ronson's retro-soul swagger.
@graph.headline: Amy Winehouse - You Know I'm No Good

@graph.description: Soft guitars, sibling harmonies and a daydream of flying away with someone: Big Jet Plane drifts in slowly and stays with you long after it lands.
@graph.headline: Angus & Julia Stone - Big Jet Plane

@graph.description: Anna Lunoe's Radioactive is a strobe-lit house banger, all clipped vocal chops, rave stabs and a low end built to rattle a festival tent.
@graph.headline: Anna Lunoe - Radioactive

@graph.name: Can't Get You Out of My Head (Cover)

@graph.description: AnnenMayKantereit and Parcels join forces to deliver a stunning cover of Kylie Minogue’s classic 'Can’t Get You Out of My Head.' Their stripped-back acoustic version breathes new life into the iconic pop hit, bringing a soulful and melancholic twist to the original's infectious energy.
@graph.headline: Can't Get You Out of My Head (Cover) - AnnenMayKantereit x Parcels

@graph.description: A pulsating, electro journey that merges industrial beats with dystopian themes.
@graph.headline: Anthony Rother - Brainshaker

@graph.description: A heavy, crawling riff, stomping handclaps and a late-night text that should never have been sent: Do I Wanna Know? turns romantic doubt into slow-burning swagger.
@graph.headline: Arctic Monkeys - Do I Wanna Know?

@graph.description: Arctic Monkeys turn a jealous late-night text into a riff-heavy stomp, with Alex Turner's rapid-fire wordplay riding a fuzzed-out, swaggering guitar line.
@graph.headline: Arctic Monkeys - R U Mine?

@graph.description: Alex Turner pleads with a lover to wake up from someone else's spell over a swaggering, hand-clapped glam-rock shuffle and a falsetto hook that sticks for days.
@graph.headline: Arctic Monkeys - Snap Out Of It

@graph.description: A cracked, ageless voice over a few acoustic chords: the original Reckoning Song is a campfire confession about growing old before the remix turned it into a festival anthem.
@graph.headline: Asaf Avidan & the Mojos - Reckoning Song (One Day)

@graph.description: 'Flyover' by Asian Dub Foundation is a politically charged track blending dub, punk, and electronic music. With hard-hitting rhythms, sharp vocals, and a rebellious tone, the song critiques social issues and challenges the status quo with raw, confrontational energy.
@graph.headline: Asian Dub Foundation - Flyover

@graph.description: Avicii wraps the Nina Simone standard in soft, swelling synths and lets Audra Mae's smoky, soaring voice carry a song about new dawns and starting over.
@graph.headline: Avicii - Feeling Good

@graph.description: A slow, menacing electro-rock crawl that erupts into a howled confession, AWOLNATION's Sail is equal parts dread and release.
@graph.headline: AWOLNATION - Sail

@graph.description: Axwell's 2004 club record in its original long form: a pumping, filtered house groove that keeps building until the whole floor is lifted with it.
@graph.headline: Axwell - Feel The Vibe

@graph.description: Axwell's piano-lit house anthem distilled to three minutes: a rolling bassline, a gospel-tinged vocal from Max'C and a chorus built for arms in the air.
@graph.headline: Axwell, Max C - I Found U (Radio Edit)

@graph.description: Ayọ pleads for a lost love over a bare acoustic guitar and a gentle reggae lilt, her husky voice carrying more ache than any big arrangement could.
@graph.headline: Ayọ - Down On My Knees

@graph.description: Bright synths and Quinn XCII's easy vocal paint a road-trip memory of summers when you and your friends felt untouchable.
@graph.headline: ayokay, Quinn XCII - Kings of Summer

@graph.description: 'The River' by Bakermat is a soulful and uplifting track that blends deep house rhythms with gospel-inspired vocals, creating a captivating experience that invites listeners to reflect and feel inspired.
@graph.headline: Bakermat - The River

@graph.description: Bright, bouncing and slightly unhinged, Galactical sends Basement Jaxx and singer Vula off into space on a house groove built for dancing in zero gravity.
@graph.headline: Basement Jaxx - Galactical

@graph.description: 'Soul Intoxication (Lonely Boy's Detox Dub)' is a hypnotic electronic track that blends elements of dub, house, and ambient music. This remix explores themes of emotional cleansing and introspection through its immersive soundscape.
@graph.headline: Soul Intoxication (Lonely Boy's Detox Dub)

@graph.description: Two and a half minutes of warped, woozy funk: Ben Khan's cool falsetto slides over wobbling synths, guitar stabs and brass that sounds trapped inside a bubble.
@graph.headline: Ben Khan - Savage

@graph.description: A strutting, paranoid electro-rock stomp where Joywave's Daniel Armbruster sneers the hook over clipped funk guitar, heavy handclaps and a bassline built for headphones and dance floors alike.
@graph.headline: Big Data, Joywave - Dangerous

@graph.description: 'Káta Rókkar' by Björk is a captivating track that showcases her unique blend of electronic and organic sounds. The song features intricate arrangements and emotive vocals, drawing listeners into a world of layered textures and rich sonic landscapes.
@graph.headline: Björk - Káta Rókkar

@graph.description: Blankets carries the Mockingjay murder ballad out of the woods and onto the dancefloor, setting its chilling refrain against a pulsing electronic beat.
@graph.headline: Blankets - The Hanging Tree

@graph.description: Bob Moses stretch a smoky, heartsick vocal across a slow-burning deep house groove, all brooding guitar, rolling bass and late-night tension that never quite breaks.
@graph.headline: Bob Moses - Tearing Me Up

@graph.description: A laid-back, smoky slice of deep house where a sweet disco bassline meets a bluesy vocal, Smokin' Joe smoulders rather than explodes.
@graph.headline: Bobby Nourmand - Smokin' Joe

@graph.description: A crunching dance-rock riff, a strutting beat and a hook about the way you move: Bodyrockers' 2005 floor-filler is pure, unashamed swagger.
@graph.headline: Bodyrockers - I Like The Way (Radio Edit)

@graph.description: A vibrant collaboration that melds Bonaparte's theatrical flair with Acid Pauli's eclectic sound, 'Not Today' delivers a captivating blend of electronic beats and lyrical introspection.
@graph.headline: Bonaparte, Acid Pauli - Not Today

@graph.description: Branko's global club sound in miniature: thick bass, chattering percussion and the voices of SKIP&DIE and Fellow trading lines over a gleaming, gold-plated groove.
@graph.headline: Branko, SKIP&DIE, Fellow - Made of Gold

@graph.description: An eclectic blend of electronic grooves, sultry vocals, and cosmopolitan charm, inspired by Istanbul’s vibrant energy.
@graph.headline: Brazilian Girls - Karaköy

@graph.description: Bright acoustic strumming over a gentle electronic beat, Broken Back's breakthrough single sounds like optimism earned the hard way.
@graph.headline: Broken Back - Happiest Man on Earth (Radio Edit)

@graph.description: 'Small Town Boy' by Bronski Beat is a profound narrative of isolation, identity, and the struggle for acceptance, resonating with those who feel the need to escape and fight for their place in the world.
@graph.headline: Bronski Beat - Small Town Boy

@graph.description: 'Because of You' by C2C featuring Pigeon John is a vibrant blend of hip-hop, electronic, and soul. The track combines smooth grooves with uplifting lyrics, celebrating gratitude and the impact others have on our lives.
@graph.headline: C2C feat. Pigeon John - Because of You

@graph.description: Soft beats, sunny loops and a sampled Son House blues voice: Ourson is a short, cuddly piece of chillout that feels like a teddy bear rendered in warm sound.
@graph.headline: Camel Power Club - Ourson

@graph.description: A hypnotic remix by Roman Flügel that transforms 'Idle Eyes' into a minimalist, ethereal journey through electronic soundscapes.
@graph.headline: C.A.R - Idle Eyes (Roman Flügel Remix)

@graph.description: 'Lone Digger' is a vibrant electro-swing track by Caravan Palace that combines vintage jazz elements with modern electronic beats. The song creates an infectious, danceable rhythm that invites listeners to join the party.
@graph.headline: Lone Digger | Caravan Palace

@graph.description: 'WAP' is a bold and provocative hip-hop track by Cardi B featuring Megan Thee Stallion. The song combines assertive lyrics with a catchy beat, celebrating female empowerment and sexuality in an unapologetic manner.
@graph.headline: Cardi B - WAP (feat. Megan Thee Stallion)

@graph.description: 'Star Guitar' is a mesmerizing electronic track by The Chemical Brothers. The song's hypnotic beats and ethereal synths create a captivating journey through sound, perfectly complemented by its iconic music video.
@graph.headline: The Chemical Brothers - Star Guitar

@graph.description: 'The Salmon Dance' is a quirky and playful electronic track by The Chemical Brothers, featuring rapper Fatlip. The song blends funky beats with humorous lyrics about a fish-inspired dance, creating a unique and memorable listening experience.
@graph.headline: The Chemical Brothers - The Salmon Dance

@graph.description: Chet Faker's smoky late-night soul over a slow, finger-snapping electronic groove, a minimal track that gets all its heat from his weathered voice and a bassline that barely moves.
@graph.headline: Chet Faker - Gold

@graph.description: A languid saxophone line, a lazy, warm beat and Chet Faker's husky croon make this Built on Glass lead single the definition of late-night electronic soul.
@graph.headline: Chet Faker - Talk Is Cheap

@graph.description: A bold, satirical journey through electroclash, blending subversion, self-expression, and DIY aesthetics.
@graph.headline: Chicks On Speed - Euro Trash Girl

@graph.description: This song delivers a captivating blend of electronic beats and urban vibes. Its infectious energy and engaging lyrics create an atmosphere that invites listeners to embrace their true selves.
@graph.headline: Chris Lorenzo & The Streets - Take Me as I Am

@graph.description: A slow Sunday-afternoon deep house cut on the Paris label La Belle Records, all warm chords, an unhurried beat and a soft vocal that drifts in and out of the haze.
@graph.headline: CLAAP!, S.A.N.T.A.N.A. - Dimanche

byArtist.name: Claptone, Clap Your Hands Say Yeah

@graph.description: Claptone sets Alec Ounsworth's fragile, quavering indie vocal over a patient deep house groove, a dancefloor track that sounds like it is mourning something.
@graph.headline: Claptone, Clap Your Hands Say Yeah - Ghost

@graph.description: 'Biggest & The Best' is an energetic track by Clawfinger that combines rap metal and industrial elements. The song delivers a powerful critique of ego and self-importance, creating a high-octane listening experience.
@graph.headline: Biggest & The Best | Clawfinger

@graph.description: Cléa Vincent turns Ace of Base's 1992 hit into breezy, homespun French synth-pop, softening its reggae-pop strut into a dreamy, lo-fi bedroom groove.
@graph.headline: Clea Vincent - All that she wants

@graph.description: Cold, pulsing analogue-style synths and a detached vocal make Codec & Flexor's electroclash-era club hit sound like a rave remembered through frosted glass.
@graph.headline: Codec & Flexor - Time Has Changed (Original)

@graph.description: An electrifying fusion of minimal electro and melodic techno, reimagined with Northern Lite's signature touch.
@graph.headline: Time Has Changed (Northern Lite Remix) - Codec & Flexor

@graph.name: Get Ready for the Young Folks

@graph.description: 'Get Ready for the Young Folks' by Controller 7 is an exhilarating blend of electronic and hip-hop influences that captures the spirit of youth and adventure.
@graph.headline: Controller 7 - Get Ready for the Young Folks

@graph.description: Corinne Bailey Rae's sun-dappled soul-pop single is a gentle invitation to let your hair down, all breezy guitar, brushed drums and a warm voice telling you to grow into yourself.
@graph.headline: Corinne Bailey Rae - Put Your Records On

@graph.description: One phrase, one bassline and seven minutes of perfect repetition: Around the World is Daft Punk proving that a loop can be a whole world on its own.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk - Around the World

@graph.description: Nile Rodgers tells his own story in the third of Daft Punk's Collaborators films, a warm, funny portrait of the guitarist whose rhythm runs through Random Access Memories.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk - Episode 3, Nile Rodgers

@graph.description: Recorded live at Bercy, Daft Punk fold the sunny house bounce of Face to Face into the jittery robot funk of Short Circuit, and the pyramid crowd goes up with it.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk - Face to Face / Short Circuit

@graph.description: Giorgio Moroder tells his own origin story over a click track, then Daft Punk unfold nine minutes of arpeggiated disco, live jazz drums and strings into a time-travelling tribute to the sound he invented.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk - Giorgio by Moroder

@graph.description: The curtain-raiser of Random Access Memories: live drums, Nile Rodgers' guitar and a vocoder mission statement announcing that Daft Punk came back to make music breathe again.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk - Give Life Back to Music

@graph.description: A chopped funk loop and a robot reciting a workout mantra: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger is Daft Punk turning a sample into one of the most quoted hooks of the century.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk - Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger

byArtist.name: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers

@graph.description: Nile Rodgers' chicken-scratch guitar, Pharrell's easy falsetto and Daft Punk's robot choir turn a four-chord loop into the most irresistible disco revival of the 2010s.
@graph.headline: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers - Get Lucky (Radio Edit)

@graph.description: Trentemøller strips Karen O away and leaves only the nightmare: a throbbing, sinister synth drive that sounds like a car speeding down a Lynchian highway at night.
@graph.headline: David Lynch, Karen O - Pinky's Dream (Trentemøller Remix Instrumental)

@graph.description: 'Too Drunk to Fuck' by Dead Kennedys is a punk rock anthem that critiques drunken behavior and its implications on relationships. With its energetic tempo and sharp lyrics, the song captures the essence of the punk movement's irreverence and social commentary.
@graph.headline: Dead Kennedys - Too Drunk to Fuck

@graph.description: Depeche Mode's jagged litany of mistakes, hammered out live in Barcelona with snarling synths, live drums and Dave Gahan relishing every bad decision.
@graph.headline: Depeche Mode - Wrong (Live in Barcelona)

inAlbum.name: Late Night Tales: Nightmares on Wax

@graph.description: Seven unhurried minutes of Pacific dub-soul from two Fat Freddy's Drop mainstays, Joe Dukie's honeyed voice drifting over a deep, patient bassline built for the small hours.
@graph.headline: DJ Fitchie, Joe Dukie - Midnight Marauders

@graph.description: Fernanda Porto's breezy bossa melody rides a rolling São Paulo drum and bass break, sunlit samba swing meeting rattling breakbeats and deep sub-bass.
@graph.headline: DJ Patife - Sambassim (DJ Patife Remix)

@graph.description: DJ S.K.T reworks the late-90s spirit of Wamdue Project's King of My Castle into a tight, sunny house edit built around one questioning vocal hook.
@graph.headline: DJ S.K.T - Must Be A Reason (Radio Edit)

@graph.description: Drake trades bars with Kanye West and Jay-Z over a murky, minimal beat of deep sub-bass and dry drums, a cool, understated flex from the Views era.
@graph.headline: Drake, The Throne - Pop Style

@graph.description: The Sardinian techno producer closes his debut album with an unexpected, tender song of layered acoustic guitars and a fragile voice that swells into a wall of sound.
@graph.headline: Dusty Kid - Nemur (Walls of Guitars) (Extended Version)

@graph.description: A plucked marimba-like loop, a dancehall bounce and a flirtation that starts at the bar: Shape of You is the minimal pop machine that took over the world in 2017.
@graph.headline: Ed Sheeran - Shape of You

@graph.description: An introspective yet uplifting track, 'This Head I Hold' by Electric Guest brings a heartfelt message of self-reflection and resilience, with its soulful melodies and tender vocals.
@graph.headline: Electric Guest - This Head I Hold

@graph.description: An intense journey through heartbreak and self-discovery, Eli's 'Faster You Fall' blends soulful vocals with driving beats, capturing the complexity of love and vulnerability.
@graph.headline: Eli - Faster You Fall

@graph.description: 'Bird of Pray' is an eclectic track by Fatboy Slim that combines infectious beats with a captivating narrative. The song intricately weaves themes of freedom and escapism, using the imagery of the YF-118G bomber as a powerful symbol.
@graph.headline: Bird of Pray | Fatboy Slim

@graph.description: Faul & Wad Ad build a sax-lit, bittersweet house groove around the children's-choir refrain of Pnau's Baby, a song about growing up that became a European number one.
@graph.headline: Faul & Wad, PNAU - Changes

@graph.description: 'My Moon My Man' is a beautifully crafted indie pop track by Feist, characterized by its enchanting melodies and introspective lyrics. The song explores themes of love and longing, creating a captivating auditory experience.
@graph.headline: My Moon My Man | Feist

@graph.description: 'Madame Hollywood' by Felix Da Housecat featuring Miss Kittin is an electrifying electro-house track that captures the glamour and grit of nightlife, blending sharp beats with provocative lyrics.
@graph.headline: Felix Da Housecat - Madame Hollywood (feat. Miss Kittin)

@graph.description: 'Silver Screen (Shower Scene)' by Felix Da Housecat is a captivating electro-house track that weaves together cinematic soundscapes with pulsating beats, exploring themes of desire and seduction.
@graph.headline: Felix Da Housecat - Silver Screen (Shower Scene)

@graph.description: 'Sambassim' is an infectious track by Fernanda Porto that blends samba rhythms with electronic elements. The song captures the vibrant spirit of Brazilian music while exploring modern production techniques.
@graph.headline: Sambassim | Fernanda Porto

@graph.description: filous strips the Gorillaz classic down to soft plucked guitar and airy beats, and LissA's gentle voice turns the old windmill anthem into a hazy daydream.
@graph.headline: filous, LissA - Feel Good Inc.

@graph.description: 'Emerge' by Fischerspooner is a groundbreaking electro-pop anthem that blends theatrical elements with infectious beats, celebrating self-expression and the avant-garde spirit of nightlife.
@graph.headline: Fischerspooner - Emerge

@graph.description: The neo-house track that introduced FKJ: chopped vocals, warm filtered chords and an elastic bassline wrapped into four and a half minutes of slow-burning, sunlit intimacy.
@graph.headline: FKJ - Lying Together

@graph.description: A chopped-up soul vocal, wobbling synth chords and a swinging, head-nodding beat: Flume's breakout cut is two and a half minutes of pure, woozy elation.
@graph.headline: Flume - Holdin On

@graph.description: A rubbery, swaggering tech-house stomper from Berlin's Format:B, all fat bass wobble and cheeky chopped vocals, cut down to a radio-sized strut.
@graph.headline: Format:B - Chunky (Radio Edit)

@graph.description: 'Remember The Name' by Fort Minor is an anthem of perseverance and determination, emphasizing the hard work and dedication it takes to achieve greatness. With its iconic chorus and powerful lyrics, the track motivates listeners to stay focused and push through obstacles.
@graph.headline: Fort Minor - Remember The Name

@graph.description: A breezy, whistled indie-pop earworm with a chilling story underneath, the song that turned Foster The People from a home demo into a global name.
@graph.headline: Foster The People - Pumped Up Kicks

@graph.description: 'Under Control' by Freeland is a powerful electronic track blending breakbeats and rock influences. With gritty vocals and a driving rhythm, the song captures themes of rebellion, control, and personal freedom, delivered with a raw, intense energy.
@graph.headline: Freeland - Under Control

@graph.description: 'You Bring Me Down' is a dynamic electronic track by Funky Fat & Digitaria that fuses groovy basslines with catchy melodies. The song captures a sense of emotional conflict, creating a danceable yet introspective listening experience.
@graph.headline: You Bring Me Down | Funky Fat & Digitaria

@graph.description: A long, strutting electro groove released on Kompute Musik, with Mount Sims' deadpan vocal riding cold analogue-style synths and a relentless machine pulse.
@graph.headline: Future Forward, Mount Sims - Time for Livin

@graph.description: A long, prowling electro mix that keeps its shadows close: The Creep in its Capri Mix stretches Mount Sims' sly menace over six and a half minutes of pulsing synths.
@graph.headline: Future Forward Society, Mount Sims - The Creep (Capri Mix)

@graph.description: The HV Thrillseeker Mix stretches The Creep into a longer, harder club tool, with the menace of the original pushed through a relentless, driving groove.
@graph.headline: Future Forward Society, Mount Sims - The Creep (HV Thrillseeker Mix)

@graph.description: Future Forward Society and Mount Sims build a slinking, shadowy electro crawl, all low-slung bass, cold synths and a voice that seems to whisper from the corner of the room.
@graph.headline: Future Forward Society, Mount Sims - The Creep

@graph.description: 'Burn It Down' by Gabriel Vitel is an intense and electrifying track, blending dark electronic beats with emotionally charged vocals.
@graph.headline: Gabriel Vitel - Burn It Down

@graph.description: A teenage Gabriella Cilmi takes Justin Timberlake's break-up hit into smoky, live soul territory, her husky voice carrying all the hurt over a sparse, swinging band.
@graph.headline: Gabriella Cilmi - Cry Me A River (Live Version)

@graph.description: 'Cry Me a River' is an iconic jazz standard, and Gabriella Cilmi's soulful interpretation breathes new life into the classic. With powerful vocals and modern production, this version captures both the emotional weight and timeless essence of the song.
@graph.headline: Gabriella Cilmi - Cry Me a River (Cover)

@graph.description: A smoky, retro-soul kiss-off: Gabriella Cilmi watches an old flame walk out with somebody new and answers with a vocal that is pure venom wrapped in velvet.
@graph.headline: Gabriella Cilmi - Left With Someone Else

@graph.description: Stomping drums, handclaps and a shout-along hook frame Gin Wigmore's gravel-edged voice in a proud anthem for everyone who never fit the flock.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - Black Sheep

@graph.description: Swaggering and swampy, Dirty Mercy pairs Gin Wigmore's raspy snarl with a stomping groove and a sly, sinister edge, the opening shot of her Ivory era.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - Dirty Mercy

@graph.description: A stomping, hand-clapping slice of retro soul-pop from Gin Wigmore's debut, her gravel-and-honey voice making a breezy chant sound like a dare.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - Hey Ho

@graph.description: Gin Wigmore's smoky rasp prowls over stomping drums and a swaggering, bluesy strut, a midnight hunt sung by someone who fully intends to win.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - Kill Of The Night

@graph.description: A stomping, hand-clapped blues-soul strut in which Gin Wigmore's raspy, fearless voice lays out exactly the kind of man she wants.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - Man Like That

@graph.description: Gin Wigmore's comeback single hits like a jolt of adrenaline, pounding drums and a chant-along chorus pushing her husky voice towards a fresh start.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - New Rush

@graph.description: Gin Wigmore's raw-throated hook meets verses from Hilltop Hoods' Suffa and Logic on a heavy, defiant anthem about loyalty you would bleed for.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore, Suffa, Logic - Willing To Die

@graph.description: Gin Wigmore snarls through a stomping, handclap-driven blues-rock number, her raspy voice and swampy guitars squaring up to fate with a grin and a clenched fist.
@graph.headline: Gin Wigmore - Written In The Water

@graph.description: Gilligan Moss stretches Glass Animals' sticky love song into a glistening electronic daydream of chiming percussion, warped vocal slivers and a slow-blooming groove.
@graph.headline: Glass Animals, Gilligan Moss - Gooey (Gilligan Moss Remix)

@graph.description: Glass Animals' breakout is a slow, syrupy jungle of a love song, Dave Bayley's murmured vocal drifting over finger-snap beats, soft guitar and a bassline that oozes.
@graph.headline: Glass Animals - Gooey

@graph.description: 'Hard On Me' by Gorgon City is a sleek, deep house track that combines pulsating rhythms with heartfelt vocals. The track encapsulates the emotional push and pull of relationships, blending smooth production with an infectious groove that resonates on both the dance floor and in personal reflection.
@graph.headline: Gorgon City - Hard On Me

@graph.description: A sleek, sunlit house cut where Katy Menditta's soulful vocal floats over a rubbery bassline and crisp garage-tinged drums, built for the moment a club exhales.
@graph.headline: Gorgon City, Katy Menditta - Imagination

@graph.description: WEISS strips Gorgon City's Imagination down to a swinging, bass-heavy house workout, leaving Katy Menditta's voice to flicker in and out over the groove.
@graph.headline: Gorgon City, Katy Menditta, WEISS - Imagination (Weiss Remix)

@graph.description: Will Saul's CLOSE stretches Gorgon City and MNEK's hit into a long, dubby deep-house journey, the soulful vocal echoing through a late-night haze.
@graph.headline: Gorgon City, MNEK, Will Saul - Ready For Your Love (CLOSE Remix)

byArtist.name: Gorgon City, Zak Abel, Dj Anna

@graph.description: DJ Anna pulls Gorgon City's pop single into the dark: a heavy rolling bassline, Zak Abel's soulful voice in fragments and nearly eight minutes of late-night pressure.
@graph.headline: Gorgon City, Zak Abel, Dj Anna - Unmissable (DJ Anna Remix)

@graph.description: The Soulchild Remix turns Gorillaz's woozy 19-2000 into a bright, bouncing cartoon road trip, with 2-D's sing-song hook and a chorus everyone remembers: get the cool shoeshine.
@graph.headline: Gorillaz - 19-2000 (Soulchild Remix)

@graph.description: A cold, clanking Gorillaz track from Demon Days where Damon Albarn's weary vocal and Neneh Cherry's spectral backing turn a nursery-rhyme melody into a quiet alarm about children and violence.
@graph.headline: Gorillaz, Neneh Cherry - Kids with Guns

@graph.description: Bandoneon, guitar and a gaucho voice drifting over a slow electronic pulse, La Vigüela is Gotan Project's tango heading out into the open pampas.
@graph.headline: Gotan Project - La vigüela

@graph.description: 'Do Not Lose Your Steam' by Gregory Porter is an uplifting jazz-infused track that combines soulful vocals with rich instrumentation. The song conveys a powerful message of perseverance and resilience, encouraging listeners to keep pushing forward despite challenges.
@graph.headline: Gregory Porter - Do Not Lose Your Steam

@graph.description: 'Superstylin'' by Groove Armada is a high-energy fusion of house, dub, and breakbeat, featuring bold brass, reggae vocals, and infectious grooves. The track delivers an exhilarating dancefloor experience while embodying a free-spirited, celebratory vibe.
@graph.headline: Groove Armada - Superstylin'

@graph.description: A serene and immersive live session blending classical piano, ambient textures, and delicate vocals, creating an emotional soundscape.
@graph.headline: Hania Rani - Full Performance (Live on KEXP)

@graph.description: 'Five Minutes' by H.E.R. is a soulful R&B track that explores themes of longing and emotional vulnerability. With its smooth melodies and heartfelt lyrics, the song captures the essence of wanting to connect deeply with someone special.
@graph.headline: H.E.R. - Five Minutes

@graph.description: The French duo Her name their manifesto after themselves: a slow, sensual indie soul track of muted beats, warm bass and a voice that leans right into the microphone.
@graph.headline: Her - Her

@graph.description: A brief, late-night breath on Her's first tape, the French duo's velvet electronic soul pared back to mood, space and a slow, sensual glow.
@graph.headline: Her - Interlude

@graph.description: A slow-rolling deep house groove under Kieran Fowkes' soulful, yearning vocal, the Leicester duo's Crosstown Rebels release made for the last, emotional hour of a night.
@graph.headline: Him_Self_Her, Kieran Fowkes - Gone Too Long (Original Mix)

@graph.description: Hindi Zahra's smoky voice glides over a lilting, desert-blues guitar and soft percussion in Beautiful Tango, a slow dance of a song that sounds like dusk in a small room.
@graph.headline: Hindi Zahra - Beautiful Tango (Remastered Version)

@graph.description: Hindi Zahra sings a love letter to music itself, her warm, smoky voice swaying over nimble acoustic guitar and soft percussion that blend folk, soul and Berber roots.
@graph.headline: Hindi Zahra - Music (Remastered Version)

@graph.description: A tender, unhurried acoustic song from Hindi Zahra's debut, her husky voice and gently plucked guitar turning memories of old friends into something warm and quietly aching.
@graph.headline: Hindi Zahra - Old Friends (Remastered Version)

@graph.description: 'Stand Up' by Hindi Zahra is a soulful anthem infused with a rebellious spirit, blending elements of jazz, folk, and world music. Its rich, earthy tone invites listeners to rise and move to the rhythm of empowerment.
@graph.headline: Hindi Zahra - Stand Up

@graph.description: 'Discolight (Hrdvsion's NSD Mix)' is a pulsating electronic track that blends house and disco elements, creating a vibrant soundscape. The remix showcases Hrdvsion's unique style, transforming the original into an immersive dance experience.
@graph.headline: Discolight (Hrdvsion's NSD Mix)

@graph.description: This remix of the iconic 'Sweet Dreams' by Eurythmics transforms the 80s synth-pop hit into a modern deep house anthem, perfect for a summer night on the beaches of Ibiza. The remix blends the track's dark, hypnotic melodies with breezy, uplifting beats, giving it a fresh yet nostalgic vibe.
@graph.headline: Eurythmics - Sweet Dreams (Ibiza Deep Summer Remix 2015)

@graph.description: A powerful exploration of life's cyclical nature, blending raw punk energy with poignant lyrics that reflect on resilience and vulnerability.
@graph.headline: IDLES - The Wheel

@graph.name: Don't Be So Shy (Filatov & Karas Remix)

@graph.description: Imany's smoky contralto meets a sleek, pulsing deep-house remix from Filatov & Karas, turning a slow seduction into a continental dancefloor hit.
@graph.headline: Imany, Filatov & Karas - Don't Be So Shy (Filatov & Karas Remix)

@graph.description: A hypnotic, synth-driven exploration of independence, blending dark pop with an infectious groove.
@graph.headline: Indiana - Solo Dancing

@graph.description: Infinity Ink's Infinity is a bassline-led deep house anthem whose endlessly looped, half-whispered hook has been soundtracking Ibiza sunrises since 2012.
@graph.headline: Infinity Ink - Infinity

@graph.description: 'Inigo Montoya - .E.S' is a hypnotic fusion of electronic beats and introspective melodies, creating a dreamlike atmosphere that invites listeners into a reflective journey. The track's mysterious soundscape makes it both haunting and deeply engaging.
@graph.headline: Inigo Montoya - .E.S

@graph.description: Ivy Levan's smoky, swaggering vocal slinks over a sleek, bass-heavy pop beat with Cadre in tow, a song that fits its title: tight, dark and made to measure.
@graph.headline: Ivy Levan, CADRÉ - Like A Glove

@graph.description: An early Jain song from the Hope EP, her bright, slightly mischievous voice riding a homemade beat that mixes pop simplicity with the rhythmic colours of her travelling childhood.
@graph.headline: Jain - City

@graph.description: Jain's debut hit is a two-and-a-half-minute burst of handclaps, whistled melody and Afro-pop bounce, light on its feet and impossible not to hum.
@graph.headline: Jain - Come

@graph.description: Jain's light, sing-song voice and bare-bones beat-making carry a small, sunny plea for a better world on her very first EP.
@graph.headline: Jain - Hope

@graph.description: “Makeba” by Jain is an upbeat and catchy fusion of world music and electronic pop. The song is a tribute to South African civil rights activist Miriam Makeba, blending rhythmic Afrobeat influences with modern pop elements to create an infectious and energetic track.
@graph.headline: Jain - Makeba

@graph.description: Handclap-light percussion, a bouncing bass and Jain's playful, slightly mischievous delivery make Mr Johnson one of Zanaka's sunniest little stories.
@graph.headline: Jain - Mr Johnson

@graph.description: Zanaka's gentle closer, a reggae-tinged sway where Jain lets the album's travels settle into calm, sunlit contentment.
@graph.headline: Jain - So Peaceful

@graph.description: Jennifer Lawrence's eerie Mockingjay folk song recast as an uptempo, drum-heavy rebel anthem, the unaccompanied verse growing into a pounding march with strings and a dance pulse.
@graph.headline: James Newton Howard, Jennifer Lawrence - The Hanging Tree (Rebel Remix)

@graph.description: Jennifer Lawrence's bare, unpolished voice sings an eerie folk ballad that swells into a rebel anthem as James Newton Howard's strings and drums gather behind her.
@graph.headline: James Newton Howard, Jennifer Lawrence - The Hanging Tree

@graph.description: Animal Trainer fold Jan Blomqvist's hushed take on Big Jet Plane into a rolling, late-night deep house remix where longing vocals drift above a patient, pulsing groove.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist, Animal Trainer - Big Jet Plane (Animal Trainer Remix)

@graph.description: Jan Blomqvist slows Angus & Julia Stone's folk lullaby into a long, glowing melodic-house drift, his weary vocal hovering over the pulse like a plane above night clouds.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist - Big Jet Plane

@graph.description: 'Time Again' by Jan Blomqvist is a minimal techno and deep house hybrid track, featuring melancholic melodies and an entrancing vocal performance. The song encapsulates the artist's ability to create an emotional and hypnotic atmosphere while maintaining a danceable groove.
@graph.headline: Jan Blomqvist - Time Again

@graph.description: Kove drives John Newman's northern-soul plea for a second chance into rolling liquid drum and bass, the raw voice riding fast breaks and big, bright chords.
@graph.headline: John Newman, Kove - Love Me Again (Kove Remix)

@graph.name: Take It Easy My Brother Charles

@graph.description: Jorge Ben Jr's 'Take It Easy My Brother Charles' is a laid-back, funky Brazilian anthem that blends samba rhythms with soulful vocals. This classic track radiates a timeless groove, bringing together a perfect balance of cool, smooth energy with just the right amount of swagger.
@graph.headline: Jorge Ben Jr - Take It Easy My Brother Charles

@graph.description: 'Epoque' by Joris Delacroix is an atmospheric deep house track with a blend of melodic elements and driving rhythms. The song carries a reflective and nostalgic tone, taking the listener on an emotive journey through sound.
@graph.headline: Joris Delacroix - Epoque

@graph.description: A teenage Joss Stone leans into a lilting, reggae-kissed soul groove and sings about wanting less with the husky authority of a singer twice her age.
@graph.headline: Joss Stone - Less Is More

@graph.description: A laid-back fusion of dub, reggae, and electronic beats, perfect for chilled vibes.
@graph.headline: JPattersson - Elevator

@graph.description: 'We Are Your Friends' is an iconic electro house anthem by Justice Vs Simian. The track masterfully blends punchy beats with infectious vocals, creating an unforgettable experience on the dance floor.
@graph.headline: Justice Vs Simian - We Are Your Friends

@graph.description: K.Flay’s 'High Enough' is an alternative rock track with electronic and hip-hop influences. The song explores themes of self-sufficiency and contentment, rejecting external substances to find fulfillment within oneself.
@graph.headline: K.Flay - High Enough

@graph.description: KANT stretches Leo Stannard's aching vocal across a seven-minute club arrangement, melancholy piano chords and a steady deep-house pulse turning heartbreak into something you can dance through.
@graph.headline: KANT, Leo Stannard - Close to the Wire (Club Remix)

@graph.description: Sunny deep-house chords and a warm, raspy BullySongs vocal: Get What You Came For is an easygoing dancefloor invitation that never pushes, only pulls you in.
@graph.headline: Kav Verhouzer, BullySongs - Get What You Came For

@graph.description: A smooth, sunlit groove from Kazy Lambist that blends laid-back electronic beats with a playful melody, capturing a breezy, carefree mood.
@graph.headline: Kazy Lambist - Doing Yoga

@graph.description: Kele Okereke opens his after-hours record Trick in a whisper: a cool, late-night house groove about the electricity of meeting someone new.
@graph.headline: Kele - First Impressions

@graph.description: 'Moments' by Klangkarussell is an enchanting electronic track that blends deep house vibes with melodic undertones. The song creates a euphoric atmosphere, inviting listeners to immerse themselves in a soundscape that evokes feelings of nostalgia and joy.
@graph.headline: Klangkarussell - Moments

@graph.description: 'We Want Your Soul' by Klangkarussell is a high-energy electronic track that critiques modern consumerism. With its hypnotic beats and provocative sampled lyrics, the song delivers a bold message while maintaining an infectious groove.
@graph.headline: Klangkarussell - We Want Your Soul

@graph.name: Man On the Moon (Miguel Campbell Remix)

@graph.description: Miguel Campbell turns Alice Phoebe Lou's wistful moon song into a warm, rolling nu-disco groove, her voice floating weightless over a bassline that never stops gently pushing forward.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On the Moon (Miguel Campbell Remix)

@graph.description: KlangKuenstler wraps Alice Phoebe Lou's soft, folk-tinged voice in a warm, unhurried deep house shuffle that feels like a slow drive home under a full moon.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler, Alice Phoebe Lou - Man On the Moon

@graph.description: A late-night techno roller from Berlin's Klangkuenstler: a big, rounded bassline, a gritty sawtooth lead and a bed of vinyl crackle that makes the dark groove feel strangely warm.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler - Golden

@graph.description: A six-minute house workout from Klangkuenstler's early, groove-first years, built for the long middle stretch of a club night when the floor just wants to jack.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler - Jam Master Jack (Original Mix)

@graph.description: A rolling tech-house groove with classic house warmth underneath: Soul Digger finds the soul in the machine and keeps the floor moving for almost seven minutes.
@graph.headline: Klangkuenstler - Soul Digger (Original Mix)

@graph.description: A hushed, late-summer slow jam from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a feather-light falsetto floats over soft keys and a patient, rubbery beat.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Entropy

@graph.description: A hushed, slow-burning slice of electronic soul from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a fragile falsetto floats over muted beats and a heart too stunned to move.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Paralyzed

@graph.description: A slow, stripped-down slice of dark electronic R&B from the Dutch duo Klyne, where a soft, close-miked voice drifts over sparse beats and muted synths.
@graph.headline: Klyne - Waiting

@graph.description: A mesmerizing blend of electronic and experimental sounds, 'Saschienne' showcases Knopfauge's unique ability to weave intricate rhythms with haunting melodies.
@graph.headline: Knopfauge - Saschienne

@graph.description: 'On The Streets (Let Freedom)' by Kollektiv Turmstrasse is an atmospheric electronic track that blends deep beats with a message of liberation and freedom.
@graph.headline: Kollektiv Turmstrasse - On The Streets (Let Freedom)

@graph.description: Kölsch's melodic techno meets Tomas Høffding's warm, weathered voice in Bloodline, a widescreen, slow-burning track that swells like a sunrise over the booth.
@graph.headline: Kölsch - Bloodline (feat. Tomas Høffding)

@graph.description: Deep, dark bass, insistent drums and Sian Evans' voice cutting through the fog: Addict opens Kosheen's Independence with the pull of something you cannot quit.
@graph.headline: Kosheen - Addict

@graph.description: 'Inner Galactic Lovers' by Kutiman is an eclectic blend of funk, jazz, and electronic elements that creates a cosmic soundscape. With its captivating grooves and lush instrumentation, the track transports listeners to a vibrant, otherworldly realm.
@graph.headline: Kutiman - Inner Galactic Lovers

@graph.description: Soft-focus tropical house from Kygo, with plucked melodies and a warm, pleading vocal from Maty Noyes asking someone not to leave just yet.
@graph.headline: Kygo, Maty Noyes - Stay

@graph.description: A three-minute haze of blurred synths, soft beats and a distant, weightless voice, Navy Light feels like city lights seen through rain on a night bus window.
@graph.headline: Labyrinth Ear - Navy Light

@graph.description: Captivating blend of synth-pop and electronic vibes, showcasing the band's signature sound.
@graph.headline: Ladytron - Seventeen

@graph.description: Matthieu Chedid's Malian project gathers Toumani Diabaté's cascading kora and the voices of Amadou & Mariam into a warm, rolling love letter to the soul of Mali.
@graph.headline: Lamomali, -M-, Toumani Diabaté, Amadou & Mariam - L'Âme Au Mali

@graph.description: Lekota's I Used To combines nostalgic melodies with a modern electronic sound, creating an emotive and introspective listening experience.
@graph.headline: Lekota - I Used To

byArtist.name: Lilly Wood and The Prick, Robin Schulz

@graph.name: Prayer in C (Robin Schulz Radio Edit)

@graph.description: Robin Schulz lifts a mournful French folk song onto a bouncing deep-house beat, Nili Hadida's bleak lyric and a looping guitar riff becoming one of the biggest summer hits of 2014.
@graph.headline: Lilly Wood and The Prick, Robin Schulz - Prayer in C (Robin Schulz Radio Edit)

@graph.description: The essence of carefree nights and the bittersweet feeling of saying goodbye to good times.
@graph.headline: Lipka - No More Bier

@graph.description: 'One Night In Rio' by Louie Austen is a smooth and seductive jazz-infused track, capturing the exotic allure and mystery of a fleeting night in the vibrant city of Rio.
@graph.headline: Louie Austen - One Night In Rio

@graph.description: A dark and pulsating techno anthem that delves into themes of desire, control, and liberation.
@graph.headline: Louisahhh - Like A Vice

@graph.description: An electrifying remix that merges industrial techno intensity with a punk ethos, creating a visceral and rebellious sonic experience.
@graph.headline: Louisahhh - Love Is a Punk (Vitalic Remix)

@graph.description: 'FCKRZ' is an electrifying electronic track by Luca Malina, blending deep house rhythms with vibrant melodies. The song captures the essence of nightlife and dance culture, creating an immersive auditory experience.
@graph.headline: Luca Malina - FCKRZ

@graph.description: 'Cooler Than Me' by Lucky Luke is a fresh take on Mike Posner's original hit, blending deep house and electronic elements to create a laid-back, catchy anthem. The track brings a modern, chill vibe while retaining the edgy attitude of the original lyrics.
@graph.headline: Lucky Luke - Cooler Than Me

@graph.description: An immersive, downtempo track that blends atmospheric beats and haunting melodies, capturing a sense of mystery and depth.
@graph.headline: Lulu's Theme (feat. Trentemøller)

@graph.description: A lush, downtempo track that combines soulful vocals and deep beats, creating an alluring atmosphere of sweetness and allure.
@graph.headline: Sweeter Than Sweet (feat. Alice Carreri)

@graph.description: A hard-hitting track that explores themes of excess and the dark side of consumer culture.
@graph.headline: Mafia Kvlb - Credit Card

@graph.description: Mando Diao trade garage-rock grit for a disco-rock floor-filler, a pulsing four-to-the-floor beat and a shout-along chorus about needing someone to dance with.
@graph.headline: Mando Diao - Dance With Somebody (Radio Version)

@graph.description: 'Hush Now' by Marbert Rocel is a soulful downtempo track that blends electronic elements with soothing melodies, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and introspection.
@graph.headline: Marbert Rocel - Hush Now

@graph.description: Refreshing fusion of deep house and ambient electronica.
@graph.headline: Marcu Rares - Camimosa

@graph.description: Nearly eight minutes of sleek Euro-house: Marcus Marr's springy bass and bright synths carry Nick Murphy's smoky voice towards a long, glittering dancefloor release.
@graph.headline: Marcus Marr, Nick Murphy - Birthday Card

@graph.description: Marcus Marr and Chet Faker meet in a sweaty, bass-heavy disco-funk jam where a soulful plea about a relationship going wrong becomes a reason to dance.
@graph.headline: Marcus Marr, Nick Murphy - The Trouble With Us

@graph.description: A nine-minute minimal journey from Jena, Marek Hemmann's Gemini unfolds in warm, melodic synth patterns that twist slowly around a soft but insistent kick.
@graph.headline: Marek Hemmann - Gemini

@graph.description: Soulwax strip Metronomy's sixties-tinged pop down to a gleaming machine groove and then rebuild it, six and a half minutes of arpeggios, cowbell-bright drums and slow-burning release.
@graph.headline: Metronomy - Love Letters (Soulwax Remix)

inAlbum.name: HIStory - Past, Present and Future, Book I

@graph.description: One of pop's most recognisable bass lines carries Michael Jackson's paranoid tale of a paternity claim, a tight, shadowy groove that sounds as sharp now as it did on Thriller.
@graph.headline: Michael Jackson - Billie Jean

@graph.description: A slow, smoky synth ballad in which Michelle Gurevich's deadpan contralto toasts the giddy first months of a romance while already hearing the ending coming.
@graph.headline: Michelle Gurevich - First Six Months of Love

@graph.description: Michelle Gurevich croons a deadpan, candlelit elegy for love gone cold, with lo-fi synths and a slow-dance sway that make heartbreak feel strangely elegant.
@graph.headline: Michelle Gurevich - Lovers Are Strangers

@graph.description: 'Party Girl' is a captivating track by Michelle Gurevich, characterized by its dreamy soundscapes and introspective lyrics. The song explores themes of identity and the complexities of nightlife, creating an evocative listening experience.
@graph.headline: Party Girl | Michelle Gurevich

@graph.description: A gritty collaboration from Mickey Avalon and Eli, 'Ultra-Violence' combines raw lyrics with dark beats, diving into themes of chaos, rebellion, and survival.
@graph.headline: Mickey Avalon, Eli - Ultra-Violence

@graph.description: 'Paddling Out' by Miike Snow is an infectious indie pop track that combines catchy melodies with an upbeat rhythm. The song's vibrant production and thoughtful lyrics explore themes of self-discovery and the pursuit of happiness, inviting listeners to embrace life's adventures.
@graph.headline: Miike Snow - Paddling Out

@graph.description: 'Naiive' by Mirwais is an electronic track characterized by its infectious groove and minimalist production. The song blends catchy melodies with rhythmic elements, creating a captivating listening experience that resonates with fans of innovative electronic music.
@graph.headline: Mirwais - Naiive Song

@graph.description: 'Frank Sinatra' is an iconic electroclash track that combines deadpan vocals with raw electronic beats, offering a satirical take on celebrity culture, excess, and fame, while keeping a danceable edge.
@graph.headline: Miss Kittin - Frank Sinatra

@graph.description: A sleek and rhythmic journey into the deep house realm, featuring hypnotic beats and soulful vocals that command the dance floor.
@graph.headline: Moisture, Lucca Santucci - Headman (Club Version)

@graph.description: A smouldering piece of dark synth-pop where cold machines and a weary croon circle the remains of something that burned out long ago.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Ashes

@graph.description: Deadpan vocals, buzzing analog synths and a drum machine with attitude: Good Service is Mount Sims serving early-2000s electroclash with a sly, suggestive grin.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Good Service

@graph.description: A slow, cold-blooded crawl through analogue synths and a graveside croon, Grave turns Mount Sims' taste for horror into five minutes of nocturnal dread.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Grave

@graph.description: Mount Sims at his most driven: a tight, menacing electro pulse and a vocal that sounds determined to walk straight into trouble.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Hellbent

@graph.description: 'How We Do' is a dark, pulsing electronic track that dives into the depths of underground sounds. With gritty beats and haunting melodies, the song captures a raw and rebellious energy, drawing listeners into a world where the rules of conformity are left behind.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - How We Do

@graph.description: A short, sharp electroclash duet where Mount Sims and Jessie Evans trade sly vocals over wiry synths and a drum machine that never stops strutting.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims, Jessie Evans - Andy of Jenny

@graph.description: Mount Sims trades his electroclash gloss for the guitar-driven shadows of his post-punk turn, a short, tense blast of darkwave unease.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - New Authority Volunteers

@graph.description: A night drive with the headlights off: grinding analogue bass, clipped drum machines and Mount Sims' cool, menacing croon from the darker side of electroclash.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - No Yellow Lines

@graph.description: Seven minutes of slow-burning tension, Restless loops a nervous synth figure and a stalking beat until the repetition itself becomes the thrill.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Restless

@graph.description: Cold synth stabs and a deadpan, sneering vocal turn revenge into a dancefloor chant: Mount Sims at his most wiry, sleazy and defiant.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - The Bitten Bite Back

@graph.description: Mount Sims and drummer Toby Dammit trade the club for a scuffed, shrugging groove: What's the Big Deal asks its question with a sneer and a beat that will not sit still.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims, Toby Dammit - What's the Big Deal

@graph.description: Cold drum machines and a detached croon from Mount Sims' UltraSex, an electroclash meditation on being close to someone and still completely on your own.
@graph.headline: Mount Sims - Together Alone

@graph.description: 'Needle in the Hay' by Mélissa Laveaux is a haunting and introspective cover of Elliott Smith's original song. Laveaux's unique vocal style and arrangements provide a fresh perspective on this indie folk classic, infused with elements of her Haitian-Canadian heritage and indie rock influences.
@graph.headline: Mélissa Laveaux - Needle in the Hay

@graph.description: N.E.R.D and Clipse trade swagger and sneers on a Neptunes-built cut from the Clones compilation, all bounce, attitude and Virginia cool.
@graph.headline: N.E.R.D, Clipse - Loser

@graph.name: Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)

@graph.description: 'Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)' is a haunting ballad by Nancy Sinatra, showcasing her signature style. The song combines melancholic lyrics with a memorable melody, exploring themes of love, loss, and heartbreak.
@graph.headline: Nancy Sinatra - Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)

@graph.description: Nappy Roots turn a sunny soul loop and a sing-along hook into a Southern porch-step anthem about waking up, counting blessings and hoping today goes right.
@graph.headline: Nappy Roots - Good Day

@graph.description: A young Nicolas Jaar's slow, sultry minimal-house classic, a crooned vocal and dusty, swaying textures that famously sink from dance tempo into a long, swooning breakdown nobody wants to mix out of.
@graph.headline: Nicolas Jaar - Time For Us

@graph.description: Niklas Ibach slips Dotan's aching folk-pop plea onto a soft deep-house pulse, keeping the ache while giving it somewhere to move.
@graph.headline: Niklas Ibach - Hungry (Remix)

@graph.description: Six and a half minutes of bumping Berlin house from Nils Ohrmann: a cheeky vocal taunt, a springy bassline and a groove that never lets go.
@graph.headline: Nils Ohrmann - In Ya Face (Original Mix)

@graph.name: Sinnerman (Felix Da Housecat's Heavenly House Mix)

@graph.description: 'Sinnerman (Felix Da Housecat's Heavenly House Mix)' revitalizes Nina Simone's classic with pulsating house beats and deep grooves. This remix transforms the original into a vibrant dancefloor anthem that celebrates both the timelessness of Simone's voice and the modern energy of house music.
@graph.headline: Sinnerman (Felix Da Housecat's Heavenly House Mix) | Nina Simone

@graph.description: Solomun's vocal mix of the Noir & Haze single: a rolling, bass-heavy deep house groove under Haze's aching voice, the slow-burn anthem of the 2011 dancefloor.
@graph.headline: Noir, Haze, Solomun - Around (Solomun Vox)

@graph.description: A deep exploration of Northern Lite's track 'Trusting Blind,' showcasing their unique blend of dark psychedelic techno.
@graph.headline: Northern Lite - Trusting Blind

@graph.description: 'Too Drunk to Fuck' by Nouvelle Vague is a bossa nova-influenced cover of the classic Dead Kennedys punk anthem. This rendition transforms the energetic punk original into a smooth, laid-back track, highlighting the irony of its lyrics in a new, softer context.
@graph.headline: Nouvelle Vague - Too Drunk to Fuck

@graph.description: Nine sun-warmed minutes of organic deep house from the Bar 25 world, where Jo.Ke's gentle, sing-along vocal drifts over a loping groove made for golden-hour dancing.
@graph.headline: Nu, Jo.Ke - Who Loves the Sun

inAlbum.name: Do You Want the Truth or Something Beautiful?

@graph.description: Paloma Faith's brassy, swing-tinged retro-soul romp about a world turned on its head, with a stomping rhythm section and a voice that relishes every theatrical flourish.
@graph.headline: Paloma Faith - Upside Down

@graph.description: 'Sex 'N' Money' is a pulsing electronic track from Paul Oakenfold featuring Pharrell Williams. With hypnotic beats and provocative lyrics, the song explores themes of excess and indulgence in the world of fame.
@graph.headline: Paul Oakenfold feat. Pharrell Williams - Sex 'N' Money

@graph.description: Peaches at her most gleefully filthy: Pickles rides a stark, rubbery electro beat while she raps about desire with a grin you can hear in every line.
@graph.headline: Peaches - Pickles

@graph.description: Handclaps, a bouncing bassline and a gospel-tinged chorus make Pharrell's Despicable Me 2 song a pure shot of sunshine that became a global anthem.
@graph.headline: Pharrell Williams - Happy

@graph.description: 'The Bomb' by Pigeon is a high-energy track that merges indie rock with electronic elements. The song is a call to action, filled with powerful beats, driving synths, and intense lyrics that make it an anthem of defiance and strength.
@graph.headline: Pigeon - The Bomb

@graph.description: An energetic fusion of cumbia and electronic music, capturing the joy of celebration and individuality.
@graph.headline: Pilocka Krach - La Luna Y El Sol

@graph.description: A punchy, no-nonsense club mix from Platinum Doug, where a chopped vocal and a bouncing bassline push the dancefloor forward bar after bar.
@graph.headline: Platinum Doug - Move On (Original Club Mix)

@graph.description: Mallets, breathy vocals and a lazy tropical groove: Canopée is Polo & Pan's invitation to climb into the treetops and forget the city for four and a half minutes.
@graph.headline: Polo & Pan - Canopée

@graph.description: 'Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger' is an iconic electronic track originally by Daft Punk, reimagined by Pomplamoose. This version combines playful instrumentation with catchy vocals, creating a fresh and vibrant take on the classic.
@graph.headline: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger | Daft Punk | Pomplamoose

@graph.description: 'Feel It Still' is a catchy, upbeat track by Portugal. The Man, featuring a blend of funk and rock elements. The song’s infectious groove and playful lyrics make it an anthem for liberation and carefree living.
@graph.headline: Feel It Still | Portugal. The Man

@graph.name: Another One Bites The Dust (A Skillz Remix)

@graph.description: A Skillz chops John Deacon's immortal bassline into a strutting breakbeat workout, keeping Freddie Mercury's swagger front and centre while the drums hit like a b-boy battle.
@graph.headline: Queen, The Miami Project - Another One Bites The Dust (A Skillz Remix)

@graph.description: Recable lifts Angus & Julia Stone's wistful Big Jet Plane onto a gently rolling house groove, keeping the song's daydream of flying away intact.
@graph.headline: Recable - Big Jet Plane (Recable Remix)

@graph.description: Sun-bleached deep house with a falsetto-soul hook: Robin Schulz builds a sweet, bouncing groove around Francesco Yates and a wink to an early-2000s classic.
@graph.headline: Robin Schulz, Francesco Yates - Sugar

@graph.description: A cowbell-clacking, falsetto-laced funk-pop strut from Robin Thicke, Pharrell and T.I. that owned the summer of 2013 and then the courtroom.
@graph.headline: Robin Thicke, T.I., Pharrell Williams - Blurred Lines

@graph.description: 'Primitive' is a bold and captivating track by Róisín Murphy, blending elements of electronic and pop music. The song explores themes of instinct, desire, and the primal forces that drive human behavior.
@graph.headline: Primitive | Róisín Murphy

@graph.description: 'Walking on the Moon' is an enchanting track by Roseaux that blends dreamy melodies with ethereal vocals. This song creates a mesmerizing atmosphere, inviting listeners to experience a sonic journey that feels both otherworldly and intimate.
@graph.headline: Walking on the Moon | Roseaux

@graph.name: Once Twice feat. Rachel K Collier

@graph.description: 'Once Twice' is an uplifting house track by Ryan Blyth featuring Rachel K Collier. The song blends energizing rhythms with soulful vocals, creating an atmosphere that invites listeners to dance and feel inspired.
@graph.headline: Ryan Blyth - Once Twice feat. Rachel K Collier

@graph.description: Santé lays a deep, rolling groove under J.U.D.G.E's grave, soulful voice, six minutes of dark-room house that feels like the first clear thought after a long night.
@graph.headline: Santé, Richard Judge - Awake

@graph.description: 'A Friend' by Say Yes Dog is a lively, feel-good blend of synth-pop and indie dance. The track celebrates the joy of friendship, combining infectious beats with heartfelt lyrics.
@graph.headline: Say Yes Dog - A Friend

@graph.description: 'Tweet Tweet Tweet' by Sleaford Mods is a gritty post-punk anthem that tackles themes of social alienation and political disillusionment. With minimalistic beats and aggressive vocals, the track captures the raw frustration of the working class in modern society.
@graph.headline: Sleaford Mods - Tweet Tweet Tweet

@graph.description: Solange and Dev Hynes wrap the end of a relationship in a skittering, eighties-tinted R&B groove, a song about losing someone that somehow makes you want to dance.
@graph.headline: Solange - Losing You

@graph.description: Nine minutes of Solomun's signature deep house, Friends rides a supple, swinging groove and moody chords that keep rising just enough to keep a dancefloor leaning in.
@graph.headline: Solomun - Friends

@graph.description: A fierce and unapologetic electro-punk track that blends gritty vocals with pulsating beats to create an anthem of liberation and self-destruction.
@graph.headline: Sworn Virgins - Burning of My Clothes

@graph.description: Gnarls Barkley's frantic classic slowed into a hazy deep-house lullaby: TEEMID and Joie Tan make Crazy sound like a confession whispered at four in the morning.
@graph.headline: TEEMID, Joie Tan - Crazy (Radio Mix)

inAlbum.name: The Sun Ain't Shining No More

@graph.name: The Sun Ain't Shining No More

@graph.description: A brassy, technicolour psych-pop stomp from Denmark, Mette Lindberg's helium-bright voice riding horns and a strutting beat that make heartbreak sound like a parade.
@graph.headline: The Asteroids Galaxy Tour - The Sun Ain't Shining No More

@graph.description: The Avener wraps Ane Brun's fragile Scandinavian folk confession in a slow, rolling deep-house groove, turning a private surrender into a sunset dancefloor moment.
@graph.headline: The Avener, Ane Brun - To Let Myself Go

@graph.description: Oxia turns The Hacker and Mount Sims' cold-wave electro into a patient, rolling techno journey, all brooding synth lines and a build that keeps tightening the screw.
@graph.headline: The Hacker, Mount Sims - Traces (Oxia Remix)

@graph.name: One Night In New York City

@graph.description: 'One Night In New York City' is a pulsating techno track by The Horrorist that captures the vibrant and chaotic essence of nightlife in the city. With its driving beats and dark, immersive atmosphere, the song invites listeners to experience the thrill of an unforgettable night out.
@graph.headline: One Night In New York City | The Horrorist

@graph.description: 'Roxanne' by The Police is a timeless blend of rock and reggae, telling the story of unrequited love and infatuation with a woman living a dangerous lifestyle. With Sting’s iconic voice and the band’s unique sound, 'Roxanne' became one of the defining tracks of the late 70s.
@graph.headline: The Police - Roxanne

byArtist.name: The Supermen Lovers, Herr Styler, Cristine

@graph.description: A flirtatious slice of French electro-funk from Guillaume Atlan's project, two voices trading lines over a springy bassline until the title becomes a shrugging, grinning verdict on the night.
@graph.headline: The Supermen Lovers, Herr Styler, Cristine - C'est bon

byArtist.name: The Supermen Lovers, Jay Lamar, Jesse Oliver

@graph.description: Helsinki's Jay Lamar and Jesse Oliver stretch The Supermen Lovers' Moments into a warm, unhurried deep house glide of soft chords, rounded bass and wistful melodies.
@graph.headline: The Supermen Lovers, Jay Lamar, Jesse Oliver - Moments (Jay Lamar & Jesse Oliver Remix)

@graph.description: A warm, analog-glazed slice of French disco-funk where vocoder, pianos and a rubber-band bassline turn a fleeting moment into a long, glowing groove.
@graph.headline: The Supermen Lovers - Moments

@graph.description: 'Crystalised' by The xx is an evocative indie pop track blending minimalistic production with haunting vocals. Its delicate balance of intimacy and tension makes it a standout, capturing themes of vulnerability and complex relationships.
@graph.headline: The xx - Crystalised

@graph.description: Plucked strings, a chorus of voices and Rotem Bar Or's raw tenor make this Tel Aviv folk song feel like a lullaby sung in a dark, uneasy time.
@graph.headline: theAngelcy - My Baby Boy

@graph.description: Tiggs Da Author's raspy, swaggering vocal rides a vintage soul sample and a hip-hop bounce on a love song that melts like snow in winter sunshine.
@graph.headline: Tiggs Da Author - Georgia

@graph.description: Timo Maas's 'Shifter' is a driving progressive house track infused with elements of techno. The song features a deep, hypnotic groove, evolving textures, and a powerful bassline, making it a standout in the electronic music scene.
@graph.headline: Timo Maas - Shifter

@graph.description: 'Sandburg' by Tinush is a deep and soulful house track that captivates with its smooth melodies, textured soundscapes, and hypnotic rhythms. Its intricate production and emotional depth create a mesmerizing atmosphere that invites listeners into a reflective sonic journey.
@graph.headline: Tinush - Sandburg

@graph.description: 'Garden' is a captivating electronic dance track by Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs. The song blends lush synthesizers, pulsating beats, and ethereal vocals to create an immersive sonic landscape that's both melancholic and uplifting.
@graph.headline: Totally Enormous Extinct Dinosaurs - Garden

@graph.description: 'In Berlin' is an electrifying synth-pop track by Swedish artist Tubbe. The song captures the essence of Berlin's vibrant nightlife and electronic music scene, blending pulsating beats with nostalgic '80s-inspired synths and emotive vocals.
@graph.headline: Tubbe - In Berlin

@graph.description: 'Deluxe' by Tum Rakak is an energetic electronic dance track that blends elements of techno, house, and experimental electronic music. The song showcases innovative sound design and pulsating rhythms, creating an immersive sonic experience.
@graph.headline: Tum Rakak - Deluxe

@graph.description: 'Smalltalk' by Ultraísta is an innovative electro-pop track that blends intricate rhythms and captivating melodies, exploring themes of communication and connection in a digital age.
@graph.headline: Ultraísta - Smalltalk

@graph.description: 'Cocaine' by Vitalic is a pulsating electro track that combines driving beats with catchy synth melodies, capturing the raw energy and intensity of nightlife and the dance floor.
@graph.headline: Vitalic - You Prefer Cocaine

@graph.description: Waldeck sets Zeebee's smoky voice inside a crackling, sepia-toned ballroom swing, a downtempo daydream about a love that only lives on in memory.
@graph.headline: Waldeck - Memories

@graph.description: 'Midsummer Night Blues' is an enchanting track featuring Zeebee, blending soulful melodies with a jazzy undertone, creating a vibrant and evocative sonic experience that captures the essence of summer evenings.
@graph.headline: Midsummer Night Blues (feat. Zeebee)

@graph.description: 'Darklands' by Whilk & Misky is a moody electronic track that weaves haunting melodies and deep basslines, exploring themes of introspection and emotional depth.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Darklands

@graph.description: A hushed, smoky vocal floats over plucked folk guitar and a slow electronic pulse, turning a simple declaration of devotion into a late-night confession.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Babe I'm Yours

@graph.description: A barefoot, sun-dappled folk song with a bossa nova sway, acoustic guitar and handclaps that turn a simple refrain into an irresistible invitation to join in.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Clap Your Hands

@graph.description: Whilk & Misky blend acoustic warmth with electronic pulse on this track from My Round, a soulful voice and a steady, rolling groove chasing a simple wish: to get what we want.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - Get What We Want

@graph.description: Whilk & Misky's London soul-pop at its most direct: a warm, swinging groove and a voice that asks for exactly one thing, over and over, until you want it too.
@graph.headline: Whilk & Misky - I Want Your Lovin' (Edit)

@graph.description: WHTKD loops a soulful, pleading vocal over a warm, rolling deep house groove, a track that sounds like late afternoon turning into evening.
@graph.headline: WHTKD - Say to Me

@graph.description: Stimming wraps Yoko Duo's fragile song in velvet: a slow, organic deep house remix full of soft textures, a hushed vocal and the feeling of a room going quiet.
@graph.headline: Yoko Duo, Stimming - Close These Curtains (Stimming Remix)

@graph.description: 'Oddity' is a mesmerizing track by Zwicker featuring Olivera Stanimirov, blending electronic rhythms with sultry vocals. The song weaves a hypnotic atmosphere, inviting listeners into a world of seductive beats and alluring melodies.
@graph.headline: Zwicker - Oddity (feat. Olivera Stanimirov)
